decisions.reason: Setting the subject-field placeholder text does not change the document's default language or resolve the existing Danish-versus-English default-language conflict.
The source specifies subject placeholder content but does not change the separate rules that control labels must be unique and must not repeat field content.
Changing the text displayed in the subject field does not alter when or how placeholder text must clear upon field activation.
The source selects user-facing text for one field and does not change the required field implementation mechanism or architecture.
The subject-field placeholder has no semantic effect on bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source changes field-specific placeholder content rather than the required style catalog or its coverage.
Danish subject placeholder text does not change style prefixes, style-name language, or the styles to which the naming convention applies.
The selected subject placeholder does not modify the supported Word environment or general reliability requirements.
The field-text decision is unrelated to numbered-list alignment at multi-digit values.
The source specifies placeholder wording and does not change the required theme colors.
The subject-field placeholder decision does not alter legacy-content paste behavior, test files, stability constraints, or the unresolved formatting workflow.
The source does not affect pasted-table stability or right-hand column containment.
